description:
· Technologies / Skills : 
 ­ Java, Spring MVC, STRUTS WebService, JSP, AJAX 
 ­ JDBC, ORM framework - Hibernate, Spring persistence 
 ­ XML, HTML, CSS, JAXP, JAXB, SOAP 
 ­ Very good in UNIX, Unix shell scripting and Cron jobs 
 ­ JavaScript, JS Framework - EXT JS 
 ­ XML parsing technologies and framework 
 ­ Relational databases, writing SQL query and PL/SQL 
 
 · Application Development : 
 ­ Analysis and discussion with client on new requirement / change 
 ­ Designing of application based on discussion with client 
 ­ Implementation of requirement as per the targeted timelines in development environment 
 ­ Testing and UAT phase 
 ­ Documentation of business requirement document and design document. Writing test cases and scenarios for UAT. 
 ­ Production deployment and support 
 
 · Documentation 
 · Creation of all documents, but not limited to design, process flow, logical and physical data model, that are required for all releases. 
 · Create business requirements document, test cases and test results that are required for Service Desk 
 · Development of implementation playbooks, rollback plans, and launch support that are required for all releases. 
 · Completion and provide regular updates of system related documents to keep it current 
 Production Support: 
 ­ Monitoring of the applications, analyze and resolve failed batch jobs 
 ­ Provide data fix to resolve production issues 
 ­ Root cause analysis of issues 
 ­ Incident reporting and follow up 
 
 · Support for all releases that include coding and testing (user interface and batch) for the following 
 ­ Projects, major, and minor enhancements 
 ­ Non-emergency fixes 
 ­ Legal, compliance, regulatory and security requirements 
 ­ Support creation of ad-hoc reports and data extracts 
 ­ Business initiatives 
 
 · All deliverables (including offshore) must meet Client technology standards and QA performance expectations (including load, capacity and endurance tests) 
 · Support in analysis of new business initiatives 
 · Resolution of technical issues through debugging, research, and investigation 
 · Job scheduling and monitoring 
 · Coordination with infrastructure, architecture, security, and QA 
 · Coordination with 3rd party vendor 
 · Senior developers are expected to have 5-7 years of experience in technical expectations 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
